item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry continental airstream will persistently bring generally fine weather to southern China in the next few days. Temperatures over the region will rise gradually and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. It will be hot during the day in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 04/04 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Fine and dry.
Temp range: 17 - 24 C
R.H. range: 40 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 05/04 (Tuesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Fine and dry.
Temp range: 18 - 26 C
R.H. range: 50 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 06/04 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 27 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 07/04 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3.
Weather: Mainly fine. Hot and dry during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 28 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 08/04 (Friday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore later.
Weather: Fine. Hot and dry during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 28 C
R.H. range: 50 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 11/04 (Monday)
